instruction: Look at gui_014_handle_blank.step in SolidWorks, a handle blank with two cylindrical end bosses of diameter 18 mm and height 8 mm, centered at X=-32 and X=32, connected by a rectangular bridge spanning X=-32 to X=32, Y=-12 to Y=12, and Z=0 to Z=8. Remodel the bridge into a solid ergonomic grip that stays connected to both bosses and has a convex cylindrical top surface whose axis runs along X. In the YZ cross-section, this cylindrical top surface has radius 10 mm, center at Y=0 and Z=10, and highest point at Z=20; keep the final bridge envelope within Y=-12 to Y=12 and Z=0 to Z=20. Cut a 5 mm through mounting hole along Z at the center of each end boss. Add 0.8 mm fillets to exposed outside edges. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_014_handle_ergonomic_out.step.
